name: Miners' Gear
summary: Miners' Gear lies stored in the Silver Stream Mine after its ore ran out. Kobolds have overrun the tunnels, and the Miners' League wants the tools recovered before local guards attack.

sections.title: Supplies of the Miners' League
sections.body: The Silver Stream Mine in northern Loch Modan holds the Miners' League's stored tools. After the mine ran out of ore, the league turned its quiet tunnels into a depot for mining equipment. Kobolds soon overran the mine, took the goods, and made their nests among the crates. The league fears the dwarven gear could be wrecked in an assault by the Mountaineers or ruined by the scavengers. Adventurers are sent inside to bring the crates back to safety.

faq.answer: Miners' Gear means crates of dwarven excavation tools, including picks and shovels, stored by the Miners' League in the dry tunnels of the Silver Stream Mine.

faq.q: Why was the gear left in the mine?
aliases: why is gear in silver stream mine
faq.answer: The Miners' League turned the empty tunnels into a storage depot after the Silver Stream Mine ran out of ore. The gear stayed there until kobolds infested the shafts.
Mountaineer Stormpike directs the recovery effort for the Miners' League. He wants the tools salvaged before his fellow warriors march in to kill the kobolds.

faq.q: Where is the Miners' Gear found?
faq.answer: Miners' League Crates holding the gear are scattered through the Silver Stream Mine's shafts, in northern Loch Modan east of Algaz Station.

angles.text: As a miner, you know the worth of well-forged dwarven iron. Leaving high-grade picks and shovels with candle-wearing scavengers is a small tragedy.
As a dwarf, you may find kobolds laying their filthy paws on dwarven craft an intolerable insult, one that calls for clearing out the mine at once.
